title: flatten only one level deep but claims deep
description: flatten should recursively flatten arbitrarily nested lists, but it only flattens one level because it does not recurse on nested elements.

hidden_tests.test_nest.py:
from nest import flatten


def test_flatten():
    assert flatten([1, [2, 3], 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert flatten([]) == []
